scope: P3 origin and failure-class retry policy selection
claims: retry overrides use an exact canonical HTTP(S) origin plus a shared closed failure class
each override is complete, independently versioned, bounded, and unique after normalization
an exact throttled override produces its configured retry decision while an unmatched failure uses the global policy
paths, queries, credentials, wildcards, unknown classes, invalid bounds, and normalized duplicates are rejected
execution.failed selects against the immutable Work placement origin and persists the selected policy version through the existing atomic failure transaction

verification.environment: local deterministic config, contract, domain, actor, and store tests
